title: A Truly World-Class Filipino Entrepreneur
primary_topics: Laudation for Dr. Tony Tan Caktiong as the 2022 RVR Award for Nation Building recipient, delivered at the RVR Awards Ceremony, July 25, 2022
JFC's growth trajectory: from a single Chickenjoy store in 1978 to 6,000+ stores across 18 international brands in 34 countries
The case for JFC as a world-class Filipino enterprise: top-10 QSR globally pre-pandemic, aiming for top-5 within eight years by doubling store count and revenue
Tony Tan Caktiong's personal qualities -- humble, friendly, generous, patriotic -- and the Jollibee Group Foundation's direct-sourcing model for Filipino farmers and poultry raisers
sub_topics: JFC origin story: started 1978 by Tony and Grace Tan Caktiong as a single mom-and-pop store selling the iconic Chickenjoy
JFC's portfolio of 18 international brands in 34 countries: Philippines' Mang Inasal, Chow King; Hong Kong's Tim Ho Wan; China's Yonghe King; America's Smashburger and Coffee Bean and Tea Leaf
Stock market story: listed on PSE in 1993 at P9/share; peaked pre-pandemic at P325 (36x in <30 years); dropped to P100 at pandemic height; recovered to ~P210 at time of speech
CJP's investment nudge: 'It's time to buy JFC shares!' -- delivered in the context of a laudation, not financial advice
JFC's ambition: among top-5 publicly-listed QSRs globally within 8 years; doubling store count, worldwide sales revenue, and net income

Humorous observation on store visitation: if the awardee visited one store per day and ate a meal in each, he would not finish visiting all during his lifetime because stores multiply faster than visits

Jollibee Group Foundation: organizes, assists and funds Filipino farmers and poultry raisers to produce consistently high-quality products that JFC purchases directly -- ensuring fair mark-up for producers and high-quality ingredients for customers
CJP's disclosure: he is a non-executive director of JFC
RVR Award Board of Judges: former Finance Secretary Ramon R. Del Rosario Jr. and other members introduced earlier
JFC team: President and CEO Ato Tanmantiong named specifically

Connection to the late Ambassador Ramon V. Del Rosario Sr.: the RVR Award is given in his honor; CJP says Del Rosario Sr. 'would surely be proud that his dream for global Filipino ingenuity and pioneering spirit is fulfilled to the hilt by our Awardee'

notable_anecdotes: Chief Taste Officer: Tony Tan Caktiong's official title is Founder, Chairman and CTO -- where CTO stands for 'Chief Taste Officer,' not Chief Technology Officer. The detail captures both the man's hands-on brand identity and his sense of humor.

The 'impossible store visit': 'If our Awardee visited one of his stores daily and ate a meal in each one, he would not be able to visit all of them during his lifetime because they will be increasing at a pace faster than his visits.' -- a vivid image of exponential growth.

CJP's investment advice embedded in a eulogy: 'It's time to buy JFC shares!' -- delivered parenthetically after noting the recovery from the pandemic P100 low to ~P210, and accompanied by a board-member disclosure.
The RVR Award scarcity: 'The RVR Award is granted to only one Filipino on any given year' -- a deliberate institutional design to preserve the honor's weight.

CJP calls the awardee 'humble, friendly, generous and patriotic' in spite of building the largest QSR empire in the Philippines and one of the top-10 globally -- the 'in spite of' test applied implicitly as in other CJP laudations.

one_paragraph_summary: Delivered July 25, 2022 at the RVR Awards Ceremony, this laudation by CJP presents Dr. Tony Tan Caktiong as the 2022 RVR Award for Nation Building recipient and as 'a truly world-class Filipino entrepreneur.' CJP traces JFC's trajectory from a single mom-and-pop Chickenjoy store co-founded by Tony and Grace Tan Caktiong in 1978 to 6,000+ stores across 18 international brands (Mang Inasal, Chow King, Tim Ho Wan, Yonghe King, Smashburger, Coffee Bean and Tea Leaf) in 34 countries -- reaching top-10 QSR status globally pre-pandemic and aiming for top-5 in eight years by doubling store count and revenue. He narrates the stock-market story: listed on the PSE at P9 per share in 1993, peaking at P325 pre-pandemic (a 36x multiplier in <30 years), dropping to P100 at pandemic height, and recovering to ~P210 at the time of the speech -- prompting the parenthetical: 'It's time to buy JFC shares!' -- accompanied by his disclosure as a non-executive JFC director. He observes, humorously, that if the awardee visited one store daily and ate a meal in each, he could not finish visiting all during his lifetime because they multiply faster than visits. He praises Tan Caktiong as remaining 'humble, friendly, generous and patriotic' despite this achievement, notes the Jollibee Group Foundation's direct-sourcing model that guarantees fair mark-ups for Filipino farmers and poultry raisers, and concludes that the late Ambassador Ramon V. Del Rosario Sr. 'would surely be proud that his dream for global Filipino ingenuity and pioneering spirit is fulfilled to the hilt by our Awardee.'
